{{Article status|status=Draft|mode=Both}}

Field Procedures are practical, step-by-step instructions for completing specific tasks in ''Elite Dangerous''. They are intended to be followed while carrying out a task, from preparing a mining ship to completing an Engineer unlock or another operational workflow.

Unlike [[Game Reference|reference articles]], which explain mechanics, locations, equipment, requirements, and other factual information, Field Procedures focus on '''what to do and in what order'''. Reference articles should explain the background; procedures should help a commander complete a task.

== How Field Procedures work ==

A Field Procedure is built around a specific objective with a recognizable completion point.

Depending on the task, a procedure may include:

* prerequisites that should be completed before starting;
* equipment, materials, commodities, or other preparation;
* an ordered sequence of actions;
* warnings and common mistakes;
* an expected result or completion check; and
* troubleshooting for common problems.

Field Procedures may link to reference articles for detailed background information rather than repeating material already documented elsewhere on EDFM.
